literature.title: Dose equivalents of antidepressants: Evidence-based recommendations from randomized controlled trials.
literature.abstract: Dose equivalence of antidepressants is critically important for clinical practice and for research. There are several methods to define and calculate dose equivalence but for antidepressants, only daily defined dose and consensus methods have been applied to date. The purpose of the present study is to examine dose equivalence of antidepressants by a less arbitrary and more systematic method.

literature.title: Role of melatonin in mood disorders and the antidepressant effects of agomelatine.
literature.abstract: Disturbances of circadian rhythms and sleep play an important role in various types of mood disorders like major depressive disorder (MDD), bipolar depressive disorder (BPD) and seasonal affective disorder (SAD). Malfunctioning of the SCN-pineal-melatonin link has been suggested as the main cause for these disorders. As a rhythm-regulating factor and as a hormone involved in the regulation of sleep, melatonin is essential for the control of mood and behavior.

literature.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
literature.abstract: Seasonal affective disorder (SAD) is a seasonal pattern of recurrent major depressive episodes that most commonly starts in autumn or winter and remits in spring. The prevalence of SAD depends on latitude and ranges from 1.5% to 9%. The predictable seasonal aspect of SAD provides a promising opportunity for prevention in people who have a history of SAD. literature.title: Agomelatine bears promising potential in treating bipolar depression- a systematic review.
literature.journal: International journal of psychiatry in clinical practice
literature.abstract: The controversy of antidepressant use in bipolar depression remains controversial. Agomelatine (AGO) is an effective antidepressant in major depressive disorder (MDD), but its application in bipolar depression was little discussed. We aimed to provide a comprehensive systematic review of clinical evidence from studies examining the efficacy and safety of AGO for bipolar depression.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Neurotic depression（ICD-9: 300.4）臨床上高度重疊於 dysthymia 及輕至中度 MDD。Agomelatine 5-HT2C 拮抗作用可改善焦慮症狀，褪黑激素路徑調節睡眠品質，對此類患者之慢性低落與焦慮共病有理論支持。
Ohdo 症候群為罕見遺傳性神經發育疾病（KAT6A、MED13L 等基因突變），以智能障礙、眼瞼下垂、心臟缺陷為主要表現。無任何已知機轉將 agomelatine 連結至此基因型疾病。

literature.title: Efficacy of antidepressants for dysthymia: a meta-analysis of placebo-controlled randomized trials.
literature.abstract: The authors sought to determine the efficacy of antidepressants in dysthymic disorder and to compare antidepressant and placebo response rates between major depressive disorder (MDD) and dysthymic disorder.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 持續性憂鬱症（dysthymia）以慢性低落情緒、睡眠障礙為特徵。Agomelatine 褪黑激素路徑改善睡眠結構、5-HT2C 拮抗可提升動機與精力，機轉上有理論支持。但現有文獻（PMID 21527126）為一般抗憂鬱藥統合分析，非 agomelatine 專屬研究。
木質性結膜炎為 plasminogen 基因缺陷導致的罕見纖維素性黏膜疾病，病理為纖維素清除障礙。與 agomelatine 的褪黑激素/血清素機轉完全無生物學交集。屬 TxGNN 遠距離知識圖譜路徑推論。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 為 Ohdo 症候群的特定基因亞型，屬罕見遺傳性神經發育疾病。與 agomelatine 機轉無連結，同 Ohdo syndrome 分析。
極罕見遺傳性疾病（KCNK4 鉀離子通道突變），以嚴重智能障礙、早老外貌、脂肪代謝異常為特徵。與 agomelatine 機轉完全無關。全球報告病例極少（< 20 例），藥物再利用在此缺乏實際意義。
